title: Sr. Associate - iOS
description:
Experience – 6\-8 yrs
   

  

 Location: GIFT CITY, Gandhinagar
   

  

 Qualification: B. Tech or B.E., B.C.A. prior to M.C.A
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Proficient with Objective\-C and Swift ,SwiftUI (Good to have).
   

  

* Experience with iOS frameworks such as Core Data, CryptoKit, Security, etc.
* Experience with creating custom UI and/or extend existing UI components
* Familiarity with Push notifications and VoIP
* Understanding of Apple’s design principles and UI/UX standards guidelines
* Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance \& memory tuning with tools such as Instruments
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs to connect iOS applications to back\-end services
* Knack for benchmarking and optimization


**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Write maintainable/scalable/efficient code.
* Convert Objective C project to Swift
* Will be responsible for ensuring that the highest possible level of service is delivered to the customers
* Management of service failures and timely escalation of issues
* Co\-ordinating with various departments like product management


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications/ Experience:**
* BE in Computers / IT with at least 6 years of relevant experience
* Strong hands on experience in iOS app development.
* Effective oral and written communication skills
* Strong Analytical skills


**Training**
* Expert Courses
* Internal Labs
* Leadership Program
* Agile Coaching

title: Student Intern - AI Engineering
description:
AI\-Native Engineering Opportunities
 



  





 We’re looking for 
 **self\-motivated interns, fresh graduates, and engineers with up to 3 years of experience** 
  CSE/IT/AIML/ICT/ECE Who enjoy turning unclear problems into useful products. You might build an API, improve an AI workflow, test a difficult edge case, or create an automation that saves someone hours.
 



  





 You don’t need to know everything on day one. We’d love to meet you if you can build something, explain your thinking, check your own work, and keep learning. You’ll work directly with the founders on real product challenges.
 



  





 To apply, email admin@sutriva.ai with a short introduction, one thing you’ve built or improved, what you contributed, and your availability.
 



  





 Use the subject line 
 **\[Internship / Fresh Grad / Engineer] – Your Name**
